name: symlink
description: Create a symbolic link at `path` pointing to `target`. The target is stored verbatim, so a relative target is relative to the link's directory. On Windows this needs Developer Mode or elevation; without it the call fails with an `EPERM: …` message. An existing `path` is refused (`EEXIST: …`). Returns { ok: true }. Additive action: an older host answers NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: What the link points to (absolute, or relative to the link's directory).

inputs.name: path
inputs.description: Where the link is created; relative paths resolve against the host cwd.
